shortDescription: Alphabet's NASDAQ:GOOG self-driving unit Waymo on Thursday said it has closed a $5 billion term loan, marking the company's first debt financing as it looks to expand its autonomous ride-hailing service across the US and the world.Here are some details:

children: self-driving unit Waymo on Thursday said it has closed a $5 billion term loan, marking the company's first debt financing as it looks to expand its autonomous ride-hailing service across the US and the world.
PIMCO, Blackstone and Sixth Street participated as lead syndicated lenders, while Capital Group, Loomis Sayles and T. Rowe Price were significant lenders, Waymo said
Goldman Sachs served as the sole lead bookrunner, it added
Waymo launched operations in its 15th US city last month and announced an expansion to Singapore
The company closed a $16 billion equity raise earlier this year at a valuation of $126 billion

title: Alphabet's Waymo secures $5 billion term loan to accelerate expansion
